cards.name: Search the Ruins
cards.text:
Surge.
Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, raise each player's threat by 2.  Response: After Search the Ruins is defeated, reduce each player's threat by 3.

cards.name: Forbidden Descent
cards.text: While Forbidden Descent is in the staging area, the first 2 progress that would be placed on a quest each round must be placed on Forbidden Descent, instead.  Forced: If Forbidden Descent leaves play from the staging area, raise each player's threat by 2.

cards.name: Restless Evil
cards.text: When Revealed: Each Undead enemy gets +1 [threat], +1 [attack], and +1 [defense] until the end of the round. If there are no Undead enemies in play, Restless Evil gains surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Each Undead enemy engaged with you gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense] until the end of the round.

cards.name: The Great Hall
cards.text: Forced: When The Great Hall is explored, each player discards the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and chooses an Undead enemy he discarded in this way to add to the staging area.

cards.name: Curse of the Years
cards.text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each exhausted character. Each player with a threat of 35 or higher must also discard each exhausted attachment he controls.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+3 [attack] instead if the defending player does not control at least 1 Clue objective).

cards.name: Cursed Dead
cards.text: When Revealed: Put each copy of Cursed Dead in the discard pile into play in the staging area.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (+2 [attack] instead if there is a copy of the defending character in its owner's discard pile).

cards.name: Wight of Rhudaur
cards.text: While the current quest has 1 or more progress on it, Wight of Rhudaur gains surge.  While the current quest has 0 progress on it, Wight of Rhudaur gains doomed 2.

cards.name: Amarthiúl
cards.text: Response: After an enemy engages a player, give control of Amarthiul to that player.  If Amarthiul leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Quiet the Spirits
cards.text: While Quiet the Spirits is the current quest, each Undead enemy that enters play immediately engages the player with the highest threat. Enemies that engage a player from this effect contribute their [threat] to the total [threat] in the staging area until the end of the phase.  Forced: After an enemy is destroyed, place 2 progress on Quiet the Spirits.  When this quest is defeated, flip it over.
cards.back_text: Action: Exhaust Amarthiul or a hero to claim Daechanar's Brand. Then, attach Daechanar's Brand to that character.  Attached character gets +1 [attack] while attacking Undead enemies.

cards.name: Ruins of Arnor
cards.text: Forced: After the "when revealed" effect of a treachery card is canceled, raise each player's threat by 2.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys a character, the defending player raises his threat by 2.

cards.name: Seal the Tomb
cards.text:
Surge.
Forced: At the end of the refresh phase, discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Return the topmost Undead enemy in the encounter discard pile to the staging area.

cards.name: Decipher Ancient Texts
cards.text: While Decipher Ancient Texts is the current quest, allies get -2 [willpower].  Action: Pay 1 resource to place 1 progress on Decipher Ancient Texts. (Any player may trigger this action. Limit 3 times per round.)  When this quest is defeated, flip it over.
cards.back_text: Action: Exhaust Amarthiul or a hero to claim Orders from Angmar. Then, attach Orders from Angmar to that character.  Attached character gets +1 [defense] while defending against Undead enemies.

cards.name: Dark Covenant
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. The first player must either remove X progress from among the quests in play, or assign X damage among characters he controls. X is the total [threat] of the discarded cards.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, raise your threat by the destroyed character's [willpower].

cards.name: Centuries of Sorrow
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: The first player must choose a new quest to be the current quest, if able.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the defending player does not control at least 1 Clue objective, this attack is considered undefended.

cards.name: Haunting Fog
cards.text: When Revealed: Each player must exhaust a character he controls. Attach Haunting Fog to the current quest. (Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached quest gets +6 quest points.")

cards.name: Eerie Halls
cards.text: Action: Raise your threat by 1 to lower the [threat] of Eerie Halls by 1 until the end of the phase. Any player may trigger this action.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If the defending player does not control at least 1 Clue objective, the attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one.

cards.name: Secrets of Rhudaur
cards.text: Setup: Make The Great Hall the active location. Set Thaurdir aside, out of play. Add the 3 Treachery of Rhudaur side quests to the staging area, quest side faceup. Search the encounter deck for 1 copy of Ancient Causeway, and add it to the staging area (2 copies instead if there are 3 or 4 players in the game). The first player gains control of Amarthiul.
cards.back_text: Time 5. Forced: After the last time counter is removed from Secrets of Rhudaur, remove each Treachery of Rhudaur side quest from the game and immediately advance to stage 2.  During the quest phase, Secrets of Rhudaur cannot be chosen as the current quest.  If there are no Treachery of Rhudaur side quests in play, immediately advance to stage 2.

cards.name: Dead Lord
cards.text: Forced: After Dead Lord engages you, put the topmost Undead enemy in the discard pile into play engaged with you.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack]. If this attack destroys a character, reveal 1 encounter card.

cards.name: Sift Through the Debris
cards.text: While Sift Through the Debris is the current quest, each location in the staging area gets +1 [threat].  Forced: After a location is explored, place 2 progress on Sift through the Debris.  When this quest is defeated, flip it over.
cards.back_text: Action: Exhaust Amarthiul or a hero to claim Heirloom of Iarchon. Then, attach Heirloom of Iarchon to that character.  Attached character gets +1 [willpower].

cards.name: Ghostly Ruins
cards.text: Any time the encounter deck runs out of cards, return the topmost Undead enemy in the encounter discard pile to the staging area before resetting the encounter deck.  Travel: Return the topmost Undead enemy in the encounter discard pile to the staging area.

cards.name: The Treachery of Rhudaur
cards.text: Rulesheet Card Side 1

cards.name: Thaurdir
cards.text:
Indestructible. Cannot have attachments.
Forced: After a treachery card with the Sorcery trait is revealed from the encounter deck, Thaurdir heals 3 damage and makes an immediate attack against the first player.

cards.name: Traitorous Wight
cards.text: Forced: When Traitorous Wight engages a player, remove 2 progress from each quest card in play.
cards.shadow: Shadow: For each point of damage dealt by this attack, remove 1 progress from each quest in play.

cards.name: Tragic Discovery
cards.text: When Revealed: Raise each player's threat by the [threat] of the active location.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Defending player either raises his threat by 3, or this attack is considered undefended.

cards.name: Decrepit Remains
cards.text: While Decrepit Remains is in the staging area, each location and quest in the staging area gets +2 quest points.
cards.shadow: Shadow: For each point of damage dealt by this attack, remove 1 progress from each quest in play.

cards.name: Thaurdir's Pursuit
cards.text: When Revealed: Add Thaurdir to the staging area. Each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for an Undead enemy and adds it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Thaurdir's Pursuit has -5 quest points for each Clue objective attached to a character.  This stage cannot be defeated while Thaurdir has any hit points remaining. When this stage is defeated, the players win the game.

cards.name: Ancient Causeway
cards.text: Forced: When Ancient Causeway is explored, raise each player's threat by 2.
